visualCharacteristics: Base: purple full-width band, centered white content — a round ~72px icon (e.g. phone) above a heading/bold contact line ("Got a Question? Call 1-877-858-6507"), a text line (TDD phone) and an optional button (e.g. "Find a PCP or doctor in the network" / "Visit DocFind »"). Option downloads: grey rounded sidebar box, left-aligned, with a purple "Downloads" heading preceded by a download icon, bold year subheadings and lists of inline underlined PDF links followed by "(PDF) »".
contentPattern: Free-form rows/cells. A cell holding only an image or icon becomes the icon (base only); everything else is content: heading, paragraphs and an optional link styled as a button. For downloads: a "Downloads" heading, then year subheadings (headings or bold paragraphs) each followed by paragraphs or lists of PDF links; links stay inline, never buttons.
usage: Base: contact or find-a-doctor call-to-action band near the end of the homepage and plan pages. downloads: right-sidebar list of plan PDF documents on plan detail pages (HMO, HealthInvestor HMO).
reuseGuidance: Use the base for any coloured icon + heading + text (+ button) callout band; use downloads for a boxed list of document links. Do not use for plain text that a styled section could carry.
